Remedial measures (Shanti) and checking for beneficial aspects or high SAV bindus are recommended to mitigate the dosha.

Rahu_4.practitioner_deep_dive: Gochara of Rahu in the 4th house (Sukha Bhava). Generally considered an inauspicious transit for this malefic planet. It tends to afflict the significations of the house, bringing challenges related to ambition, illusion, foreign elements, and obsession. Remedial measures (Shanti) and checking for beneficial aspects or high SAV bindus are recommended to mitigate the dosha.
